```{r helpers, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Remove the trailing "_<batch>" suffix appended to sample IDs
strip_batch <- function(x) sub("(.*)_[^_]*$", "\\1", x)

# "a) X, b) Y, and c) Z" style list, used for narrative captions
letter_and_list <- function(x) {
  out <- paste0(letters[seq_along(x)], ") ", x)
  if (length(out) > 1) out[length(out)] <- paste("and", out[length(out)])
  out
}

# Color a PASSED / WARNING / FAILED status value for kable/LaTeX output
color_status <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "PASSED"  ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#006b54", color = "white"),
    x == "WARNING" ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#ffd858"),
    x == "FAILED"  ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#D2042D", color = "white"),
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# Wrap flagged cells in a red LaTeX colorbox.
# status_cols is a named vector: names are the columns in `status_df` that
# hold "FAILED"/"PASSED", values are the matching column to highlight in
# `value_df`. Matching is by row position, mirroring how the original
# per-row loops worked.
highlight_failed <- function(value_df, status_df, status_cols) {
  for (status_col in names(status_cols)) {
    val_col <- status_cols[[status_col]]
    rows <- which(status_df[[status_col]] == "FAILED")
    for (i in rows) {
      value_df[i, val_col] <- paste0(
        "\\colorbox{myred}{\\textcolor{white}{\\textbf{", value_df[i, val_col], "}}}"
      )
    }
  }
  value_df
}

# Standard PASSED/WARNING/FAILED legend used on the QC tables
pass_fail_legend <- c(
  "\\\\colorbox{mygreen}{\\\\textcolor{white}{PASSED}}", "  |  ",
  "\\\\colorbox{myyellow}{WARNING}", "  |  ",
  "\\\\colorbox{myred}{\\\\textcolor{white}{FAILED}}"
)

# Render a QC table: switches to a repeating longtable once it's too long
# for one page (>= longtable_threshold rows), otherwise scales to fit.
render_qc_table <- function(df, legend, italic_col = 3, longtable_threshold = 30) {
  long <- nrow(df) >= longtable_threshold
  df %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "c",
          row.names = FALSE, longtable = long) %>%
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = if (long) c("repeat_header", "scale_down") else c("scale_down", "hold_position"),
      font_size = if (long) 7 else NULL
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, background = "#D4D4D4", bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(italic_col, italic = TRUE) %>%
    footnote(general = legend, general_title = "Legend:", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, escape = FALSE)
}
```

```{r load-data, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- rename species column to wgs_id and fill in genus-only IDs ---
wgs_df <- wgs_result_df %>%
  rename(wgs_id = species) %>%
  mutate(wgs_id = case_when(
    wgs_id == "Acinetobacter" ~ "Acinetobacter baumannii",
    wgs_id == "Escherichia"   ~ "Escherichia coli",
    TRUE ~ wgs_id
  ))

# --- load organism code reference file ---
org_df <- read_xlsx(here("data_files", "whonet_codes_2024.xlsx"), "ORGANISM") %>%
  select(ORG_ARS, ORGANISM_name) %>%
  rename(wgs_id = ORGANISM_name, org_code = ORG_ARS)

# --- merge & clean organism code ---
wgs_df <- wgs_df %>%
  left_join(org_df, by = "wgs_id") %>%
  mutate(
    org_code_clean = case_when(
      wgs_id %in% c("Escherichia/Shigella", "Escherichia coli/Shigella") ~ "eco",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Salmonella enterica") ~ "sat",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Salmonella") ~ "sal",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus pseudopneumoniae") ~ "spn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus pyogenes") ~ "spy",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus oralis") ~ "sol",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus") ~ "spn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Staphylococcus epidermidis") ~ "sep",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Staphylococcus") ~ "sau",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Shigella") ~ "shi",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Vibrio") ~ "vic",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Klebsiella") ~ "kpn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Raoultella planticola") ~ "kpn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Pseudomonas") ~ "pae",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Acinetobacter") ~ "aba",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Burkholderia") ~ "pce",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Serratia marcescens") ~ "sma",
      TRUE ~ org_code
    )
  )

```
